# beacon

> Deterministic, tested building blocks for AI pipelines. Rust core, Python API.

beacon is the deterministic layer between Python code and an LLM: prompt templating,
JSON extraction, tool-call parsing, schema validation, text normalization, content
hashing, PII redaction, retry classification, and snapshot testing. Every block is a
pure function with the same contract: same input, same output, every time.

Install: pip install llm-beacon  (import name: beacon)
Docs: https://www.anshumanbuilds.dev/beacon/
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/llm-beacon/
Source: https://github.com/IND-Anshuman/beacon

## Optional integrations
pip install "llm-beacon[langchain]" | [llamaindex] | [pydantic-ai] | [dspy] | [openai]
